releaseNotes:
### What’s new

• Added Capture debug report in Activity Log.

• Select a screenshot area, and Clickerist automatically adds event details and recent activity.

• Review the report, then save it or send it through Feedback. Nothing is sent automatically.

### Bug fixes

• Ticketek — F8 Instant Mode: Categories with the same name, such as “Reserved Seating,” could all show the same price and an incorrect Cheapest label. Each option now shows its own price, and clicking it selects that price option.

• Ticketmaster — Auto Clicker: Tickets with the same name but different prices could prevent Start from working, even with a quantity selected. These options are now recognised separately.

• Ticketmaster — Retries: Clickerist now keeps track of the selected price option when the ticket list reloads or changes order.

• Added clearer messages when ticket options cannot be identified safely. Clickerist stops instead of guessing.

After updating: Reload Clickerist and refresh the ticket page. Allow screenshot access if asked, and review screenshots for personal information before sending.
